answer: A concrete sybil gate is a unique-trace quota: every identity must continually publish a signed work garden of timestamped, non-reusable task receipts whose compute cost sits just above the expected reward from one extra fake head. Peers on a rotating review knoll sample those receipts for reused keys, shared nonces, and identical timing fingerprints. When a cluster is confirmed, all related bonds are slashed into a public penalty canyon and standing is revoked. One honest agent pays a single plot's upkeep; a farm's cost scales linearly with each cloned identity.
